title: How to Close Your ZX Bank Credit Card

nodes.title: 1. **Clear Outstanding Dues**
nodes.summary: First step in card closure: settle all outstanding amounts such as balances, fees, charges, or EMIs on the card, and download the final statement for future reference.

nodes.title: 2. **Redeem Unused Rewards**
nodes.summary: Second step: redeem all reward points, cashback, or benefits before closure, because unused rewards will be lost once the card is closed.

nodes.title: 3. **Cancel Auto-debits & Linked Payments**
nodes.summary: Third step: deactivate standing instructions, auto-debits, or subscriptions that are linked to the card before closure.

nodes.title: 4. **Request Card Closure**
nodes.summary: Fourth step: place a card closure request through any of the channels described - the ZX Bank Asia app, ZX NetBanking, customer care, or a branch visit.

children.title: a. **Via ZX Bank Mobile App ("ZX Bank Asia")**
children.summary: In the ZX Bank Asia mobile app, login and go to Card Services to Credit Card Closure, select the card, and follow the on-screen prompts to close it.

children.title: b. **Through ZX NetBanking**
children.summary: In ZX NetBanking, navigate to Cards, then Credit Cards, then Close Credit Card, select the card, and confirm the closure request.

children.title: c. **Customer Care**
children.summary: Request closure over the phone with card details handy using the 24x7 helplines: India 1800-123-4567, Sri Lanka 011-2345678, and Bangladesh 0961-234567.

children.title: d. **Branch Visit**
children.summary: Visit the nearest ZX Bank branch and submit a written request or fill out a card closure form.

nodes.title: 5. **Destroy the Card**
nodes.summary: After receiving confirmation, cut the card (including the chip and magnetic strip) and dispose of it securely.

nodes.title: 6. **Obtain Closure Confirmation**
nodes.summary: ZX Bank sends a closure confirmation letter or email within 7 working days; customers should also check their CIBIL or credit report to ensure the card appears as closed rather than settled.

nodes.title: #### Important Notes
nodes.summary: Important notes: closing a credit card may affect the credit score, a closed card cannot be reactivated so a new application is required, and continuing charges after closure should be reported to ZX Bank immediately. Contact support through the app or www.zxbank.asia.
